title: Is this a whole new Microsoft? The fix Windows 11 campaign is already in high gear, and I'm loving that execs are seriously engaging with users | TechRadar
summary: Microsoft is prioritizing the repositioning of the taskbar in Windows 11 to allow customization such as moving it away from the screen's bottom and creating a more compact bar. Progress on dark mode is also being made, with Marcus Ash acknowledging the slow but ongoing efforts to introduce dark mode across the interface.
sentiment_reason: The focus on user feedback and the commitment to improving Windows 11, such as the prioritization of the taskbar repositioning and progress on dark mode, indicates a positive direction for the OS.
